reviews.title: Terrible customer service. Shop at Amazon or Noon instead!
reviews.text:
My exchange order turned into a nightmare. One courier collected my old items, while another was supposed to deliver the replacement. One replacement item was never delivered, yet Namshi marked the exchange as completed.

What made it worse was how they handled the issue. I had to submit two separate complaints just to get them to investigate. After the first complaint, they simply told me to contact the courier myself. Since when is it the customer’s job to investigate a courier contracted by the retailer?

After my second complaint, their investigation team admitted they had recommended issuing me a refund, but said management rejected it. At that point, Namshi made it clear they had no intention of taking responsibility for their own failed delivery process.

I had no choice but to escalate the matter through the official Consumer Protection channel via the TAMM app. حماية المستهلك من خلال تطبيق تم.

This experience reminded me why I stick with Amazon and Noon. I’ve placed countless orders with them, and whenever there was a missing item, damaged shipment, or refund request, they focused on solving the problem, not making the customer do the investigation. I’ve never had Amazon make me chase couriers or fight for weeks over a missing shipment.

If Namshi refuses to resolve your issue or you believe you’ve been treated unfairly, don’t let it go. File a complaint with Consumer Protection through the TAMM app. Companies should be held accountable when they fail to protect the

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with my experience with Namshi.

I placed my order on 20 May with a promised delivery date of 26 May before Eid. I specifically ordered this as an Eid gift for my wife, so timely delivery was very important.

Unfortunately, the order was not delivered as promised.

On the delivery day, your driver contacted me, asked me to update my pin location, and I did it immediately while on the call. He mentioned he was close to my location, but the order was still not delivered. After that, I had to repeatedly follow up with customer support through multiple emails.

The most frustrating part was the customer service experience. I kept receiving the same copy-paste replies saying the case was being prioritized, escalated, and reviewed, but no one gave me a clear delivery time or actual solution. I was even asked by email to update my pin location again, even though I had already done that earlier as requested by the delivery team.

At one point, I was told that a manager would contact me within 3 working hours, but that commitment was also not properly followed through.

The item finally arrived only after all the important occasions had already passed, which completely ruined the purpose of my purchase.

I expected much better communication and service. Delays can happen, but repeated promises without action and lack of coordination between the delivery team and customer support made the experience very disappointing.
